observations.behavior: Adds 'Read timed out' to the set of retryable errors and removes the previous comment, replacing it with a longer comment explaining that transient network blips are not customer or Amplitude problems.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the classification of a specific network error ('Read timed out') from a permanent failure to a transient, retryable failure. This allows the Temporal worker to retry the download activity rather than failing immediately, potentially recovering from transient network congestion or shared resource contention without requiring a full re-download or customer-side fix.
